name: Shadow Hunter
source:
A famous writer announces her engagement and starts to receive threats and get blackmailed. The main character is a detective tasked with identifying the stalker. As the investigation proceeds, a murder occurs. 

[Edited from [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一位知名女作家宣布订婚后，开始收到威胁并遭人勒索。主人公是一名侦探，受命查出跟踪者的身份。随着调查深入，一桩命案发生了。

[改编自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
